Messages.Author: rai...@mich.com
Messages.Body:
Got into a bit of a heated discussion over these cards. You would think they
are too simple to argue over but it happened.

Question:
Vampire A bleeds
Vampire B (tapped) plays GDs or RW untaps
Vampire B plays Deflection at SUP
Does Vampire B remain untapped or does Vampire B return to a tapped state.

I argues that he remains untapped. I won the arguement, but only cause the
loser deigned to have the question put to the VTES world.

Raille

Vampire B remains untapped. GDs and Rats physically untap the reacting
vamp and unless the vampire blocks or does something else that will make
it tap (say, block or play deflection at inferior) it will stay
untapped.
